tagline_en: High-concentration hyaluronic acid for deep, lasting hydration
tagline_zh: 高效保湿 · 深层滋养 · 弹润修复
overview_en: High-concentration hyaluronic acid that penetrates easily to intensely hydrate and lock in moisture, prevents dehydration and boosts skin elasticity and suppleness while slowing signs of ageing.
overview_zh: 含高浓度玻尿酸，帮助肌肤强效保湿滋润，减缓老化过程，维持肌肤弹性与柔韧。
benefits_en: Suited to dehydrated and sensitive skin
